name: Breaking Promises
overview: Scripture firmly establishes the seriousness of keeping promises, emphasizing that God Himself does not lie or break His word, assuring that what He has spoken will be fulfilled. Believers are called to honor their vows to the Lord without breaking their word, as failing to do so is sin that will be held accountable. Falsehood and boasting of unfulfilled gifts are condemned, highlighting the spiritual and moral consequences of breaking promises and speaking lies.
